name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: Ebola outbreak passes 5,300 deaths, mostly in DR Congo; spread to Kenya and Nigeria
state: Africa CDC said on 2 Nov the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak had caused 5,376 deaths among more than 10,000 cases, almost all in DR Congo, with deaths also in Kenya and Uganda (Euronews). ECDC counted 10,274 confirmed cases in DR Congo to 28 Oct, with eight provinces affected, and imported cases in Kenya (6 Oct) and Nigeria (20 Oct).
for_you: Follow NHS and FCDO travel health advice for DR Congo, Uganda and Kenya; UKHSA rates risk in the UK as very low.
rubric_hit: > 1,000 cases and spread to Nigeria within 30 days = Alert

sources.title: Euronews — Ebola kills over 5,300 in fastest-growing outbreak on record

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
